title: Base change of free Yoneda etale module sheaves (source-library model)
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\to X$ a morphism, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $W\to X$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $\Lambda[W]$ for the sheafification of the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\phi:V\to W}\Lambda$, with restriction reindexing by composition [lem-weil-pbc-free-yoneda-presheaf-module], [def-weil-presheaf-modules-sheafification]. Using module-valued etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], there is an isomorphism $g^{-1}\Lambda[W]\cong\Lambda[W\times_XY]$. In the source library the free sheaf is $\mathrm{Sheaf.freeYoneda}(X_{\mathrm{Et}},W,\Lambda)$, and the asserted isomorphism is $\mathrm{Etale.upperStarFreeYonedaIso}(g,W)$.

source.place: Tag 03S6 (lemma-shriek-base-change), rank-one free-sheaf case; existing proof in lean/WeilConjectures/ConstructibleSheaf/FreeLifting.lean, lines 229-261.

proof.text: The upperStar/lowerStar adjunction followed by free-Yoneda evaluation identifies Hom(g^{-1}Lambda[W],F) with Hom(Lambda,(g_*F)(W)). By the definition of lowerStar this is Hom(Lambda,F(W times_X Y)), which is Hom(Lambda[W times_X Y],F). The equivalences are natural by homEquiv_naturality_right and freeYonedaHomEquiv_comp. Coyoneda.ext gives the isomorphism. This is the existing proved source-library definition at FreeLifting.lean:234-261.

noncomputable def upperStarFreeYonedaIso {Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : Y ⟶ X) (W : X.Etale) :
    (Etale.upperStar (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) g).obj
        (Sheaf.freeYoneda X.smallEtaleTopology W (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ)) ≅
      Sheaf.freeYoneda Y.smallEtaleTopology (g.Etale.obj W) (ModuleCat.of Λ Λ)

blueprint_update.statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $g:Y\to X$ a morphism, $\Lambda$ a commutative ring and $W\to X$ an etale object [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. Write $\Lambda[W]$ for the sheafification of the presheaf $V\mapsto\bigoplus_{\phi:V\to W}\Lambda$, with restriction reindexing by composition. Using module-valued etale sheaves [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves] and inverse image [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], there is an isomorphism $g^{-1}\Lambda[W]\cong\Lambda[W\times_XY]$.

proof.text: Let $F$ be a sheaf of $\Lambda$-modules on $Y_{\Et}$. The adjunction $g^{-1}\dashv g_*$ [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image], followed by the free-module Yoneda isomorphism $\operatorname{Hom}(\Lambda[W],G)\cong G(W)$ (a map out of $\Lambda[W]$ is determined by the image of the section $\mathrm{id}_W$), identifies $\operatorname{Hom}(g^{-1}\Lambda[W],F)$ with $\operatorname{Hom}(\Lambda[W],g_*F)\cong(g_*F)(W)$. By the definition of the direct image this is $F(W\times_XY)$, which by the free-module Yoneda isomorphism again is $\operatorname{Hom}(\Lambda[W\times_XY],F)$. Each of these bijections is natural in $F$, so by the Yoneda lemma they are induced by an isomorphism $g^{-1}\Lambda[W]\cong\Lambda[W\times_XY]$.
